page.title: Assignments
page.teachersOnlyBody: Assignments are posted by teachers. Sign in with a teacher account to post work for your class.
page.noClassBody: Assignments are posted to a class. Create a class, then share its invite code with the parents.

overview.title: Assignments for {classroom}
overview.emptyBody: Post the first assignment for this class. Children see it on their start screen.

form.title: New assignment
form.requiredNote: Title and task text are required.
form.taskHint: Write the task for your class. Up to {limit} characters.
form.dueHint: A calendar date, without a time.
form.solutionHint: Never shown to children. Up to {limit} characters.

preview.title: Child preview
preview.description: This is how children of your class will see the assignment. It is saved only when you choose “Save assignment”.

child.empty: Your teacher has not posted any tasks yet.
child.helpSoonTitle: Help with school tasks is coming soon
child.helpSoonBody: You can read the task here. Hort cannot help with it yet, and nothing was sent.

discard.title: Discard your changes?
discard.body: Your unsaved text will be lost.

delete.title: Delete “{title}”?
delete.body: Children of this class will no longer see this assignment. This cannot be undone.

errors.notFound: This assignment no longer exists. Reload the page to see the current list.
errors.infrastructure: The assignment could not be saved because of a service error. Please try again.
errors.invalidId: This assignment could not be found.
errors.classroomArchived: This class is archived and takes no new assignments.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.

validation.titleTooLong: The title must be 120 characters or fewer.
validation.taskTooLong: The task text must be 4,000 characters or fewer.
validation.solutionTooLong: The solution key must be 4,000 characters or fewer.

switch.title: Switch class and discard your changes?
switch.body: Your unsaved assignment text will be lost. Save it first if you want to keep it.
